_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. config.json is gitignored.

api._comment: Set base_url to 'auto' to discover the gateway automatically via the default route (recommended for PZ Network). Or set a fixed URL e.g. http://192.168.4.1:5000

db._comment: Set host to 'auto' to use the same discovered gateway IP (recommended). Port 5433 is the PZTrack Docker default.

nfc._comment: PN532 I²C address. Default is 0x24 for Adafruit breakout with both DIP switches ON.

display._comment: SSD1306 OLED settings. Most common address is 0x3C.

button._comment: GPIO pin number for the confirm button. Wire between this pin and GND.
